notes.title: The correct order of the game
notes.content:
The correct order of the game
Just in case you miss a map
1. Novice tutorial
Train station
3. Safe place
4. Security Zone Guard Leadership
5. Take a bus or book to the safe zone train station
6. The train will transport you near the ship
7. Ship battle Rescue
8. Back to the safe area
9. Safe area Pick up a task assigned to you by the iron fence
10. Travel to the city where the virus broke out
11. Get into a conspiracy
12. Finding Jack in Ghetto
13. There are 2 ways to find each
The ending of each conversation
14. Grappling Run (False Ending)
15, Jack's anger (true ending)
